nodes.description: Immutable constant reference to the external IMerkleWalletClaimer contract at 0xD8470a6d796d54F13f243A4cf1a890E65bF3670E; used as the target of the external claimFor call.
External function that iterates over an array of ClaimArgs structs and forwards each one to the external claimer contract inside an unchecked loop.
Calldata/memory array of ClaimArgs supplied by the caller; length drives the loop and each element is forwarded to the external claimer.
Loop counter declared inside an unchecked block; incremented with ++i to iterate over the claims array.
Memory copy of a single ClaimArgs element read from the claims array on each iteration before being forwarded to the external call.

External call _claimer.claimFor(owner, index, wallet, initialSigningKey, claimantSignature, merkleProof) executed once per array element inside a loop; forwards all caller-supplied claim data to an external contract.

edges.reason: The function claimForInBatch receives the claims parameter and reads it for iteration.
The loop counter i is created and incremented inside the claimForInBatch function body.
The local claim struct is populated from claims[i] inside the claimForInBatch function body.
Execution of claimForInBatch triggers the external claimer.claimFor call, handing control to an untrusted external contract.
Each element of the caller-supplied claims array is forwarded directly into the external claimFor call arguments.
The per-iteration claim struct (owner, index, wallet, initialSigningKey, claimantSignature, merkleProof) is passed as arguments to the external call.
The loop index i controls how many times the external claimFor call is executed.
The constant state variable _claimer provides the callee address used by the external call.

normalization_plan.reason: The claims parameter only exists to feed the batch loop of claimForInBatch and carries no independent security semantics.
The loop counter i is a temporary index whose only role is to drive repeated invocation of the external claimFor call.
The local claim struct is a transient copy of claims[i] whose only purpose is to supply arguments to the external claimFor call.
